decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully captures the required review of passive-component selections to reduce JLCPCB Extended-part setup fees.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the required review of resistor and capacitor BOM selections and package alternatives for unnecessary Extended-part fees.
The fee review concerns component sourcing and BOM choices, not whether KiCad libraries and footprints are portable.
Considering alternative passive package sizes does not itself change any established board dimensions, mounting arrangement, connector placement, or other mechanical-layout state.
The source targets Extended-part fees for resistors and capacitors and does not alter interboard connector types, pinouts, or power topology.
The source does not change the LED supply voltage, level-shifter requirement, or selected level-shifter part.
The client notes that an Extended fee for the AXP component is expected but does not request a change to the AXP2101 or its power-path behavior.
The passive-component fee review does not alter the monitoring IC, measured rails, channel allocation, or monitor placement.
The source does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, module interfaces, buses, or supply assignments.
The source does not change the SPS30 SEL pin connection or I2C mode.
Although capacitor selections may be reviewed in the BOM, the source does not change the required BOOT or EN capacitance values or reset and BOOT behavior.
The source requests a sourcing-cost review of passive parts but does not change I2C resistance values, resistor policy, placement, bus speed, or cable constraints.
